# ValueMap

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class ValueMap : IEditSurface<GrayPixel>
```

Editable single-layer raster: one grayscale value (0–255) plus one alpha (0–255) per pixel, bound to a fixed canvas size. Grayscale is guaranteed by construction — there is no way to store independent R/G/B. Materialize an `Image` only at export/preview.

## Remarks

It is an [`IEditSurface<TPixel>`](Nfty.Core.Editing.IEditSurface-1.md), which is how the generic paint stack reaches it. That costs the guarantee nothing: [`GrayPixel`](Nfty.Core.Editing.GrayPixel.md) carries one value and one alpha, so a command written against the generic surface has no color to hand this map even if it holds one. Nothing on this type accepts independent R/G/B, and nothing should be added that does.
